newsitem.title: USA: Dow seen heading lower at start.
newsitem.headline: Dow seen heading lower at start.

text.p: The Dow industrials were expected to head lower at the start of trading Tuesday after on Monday rallying to their first record close in nearly two months.
But analysts said that even as profit-taking hit the Dow, which surged 143 points to 7214 on Monday, Nasdaq stocks should continue to rally.
"The market must run into some profit-taking," said Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Investments. He said the Dow could fall up to 150 points in the next few days.
